_comment: R56 part 2 (goal-first schema), 2026-09-24, Claude Opus 5.5: tests/gold/text_gold.json with its predicates mapped
by a fixed rule to the proposed schema r56/furniture_text_schema.json before any extraction; `labelled_as` keeps the labels.

Mapping: CAUSES_FAILURE -> CAUSED_BY (inverted) (3); EXHIBITS_FAILURE -> AFFECTS (inverted) (21); HAS_DEFECT -> AFFECTS (inverted) (42); IMPEDES_ASSEMBLY_OF -> not expressible (8); PART_OF -> PART_OF (22). EXHIBITS_FAILURE -> AFFECTS is the only way
this schema can place a failure on a part or product (it has no FailureMode-to-thing relation), so it counts only if the
extractor states the failure as a Defect; IMPEDES_ASSEMBLY_OF would duplicate the HAS_DEFECT triple and is not expressible.
Questions 3 and 5 read a FailureMode or Defect entity mentioned in the product's reviews (the schema attaches failures to nothing).

questions.question: Which suppliers provide the drawer rails of the Helsingborg Dresser? (domain graph only)
Which suppliers are behind the drawer rails that Helsingborg Dresser reviews report as defective? (text graph to domain graph to supplier)
Which products do reviews report as wobbling?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:MENTIONS]->(f:Entity) WHERE f.type IN ['FailureMode', 'Defect'] AND any(n IN [f.name] + coalesce(f.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'wobbl') MATCH (c)-[:PART_OF]->(:Document)-[:ABOUT]->(p:Product) RETURN DISTINCT p.product_name

questions.question: Which products are reported with misaligned pre-drilled holes?
questions.cypher: MATCH (d:Entity)-[f:AFFECTS]->(h:Entity {type: 'Component'}) WHERE any(n IN [h.name] + coalesce(h.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'hole') AND any(n IN [d.name] + coalesce(d.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'align' OR toLower(n) CONTAINS 'line up') MATCH (:Chunk {chunk_id: f.chunk_id})-[:PART_OF]->(:Document)-[:ABOUT]->(p:Product) RETURN DISTINCT p.product_name

questions.question: Which products are reported to squeak or creak?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:MENTIONS]->(f:Entity) WHERE f.type IN ['FailureMode', 'Defect'] AND any(n IN [f.name] + coalesce(f.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'squeak' OR toLower(n) CONTAINS 'creak') MATCH (c)-[:PART_OF]->(:Document)-[:ABOUT]->(p:Product) RETURN DISTINCT p.product_name
